missing_claims.claim: Whether the different published STAR Methods and detailed-protocol TE and Nextera quantities reflect intentional S3 recipe changes
missing_claims.evidence: The 2019 original-author S3 Master Protocol was independently read. Its p. 19 1xTE wash and p. 22 11 µL TD + 4 µL ATM agree with published Document S1 (mmc1 lines 3644, 3810), while 2020 STAR Methods JATS lines 491 and 509 print 1 M TE and 10 µL TD + 5 µL ATM. A later original-author 2023 chapter (doi:10.1007/978-1-0716-2756-3_3, pp. 83 and 86) independently prints TE-TW then TE after NaOH and 10 µL TD + 5 µL ATM. This later recipe does not identify which 2020 recipe was used or explicitly explain the discrepancy. The PubMed record PMID 33053333 has no linked erratum/correction, and targeted publisher/DOI searches did not locate one; this is not proof that none exists. The 2023 chapter has two independent original-source reads, but it does not resolve the historical version discrepancy.
